name: normal field answer
hard_assertion: one field changes and revision increments once

name: contextual field doubt
hard_assertion: no field changes and the same pending field resumes

name: product-cost doubt
hard_assertion: every released claim has an approved fact or calculation ID

name: correction of earlier field
hard_assertion: earlier target changes and original checkpoint resumes

name: answer combined with a doubt
hard_assertion: candidate remains provisional until explicit confirmation

name: ambiguous response
hard_assertion: no mutation and one focused clarification

name: low-confidence speech recognition
hard_assertion: no mutation and a repetition request

name: repeat
hard_assertion: only fully heard safe output is replayed

name: go back
hard_assertion: navigation changes without changing application revision

name: stop during speech
hard_assertion: local playback stops and old generation cannot re-enter

name: unsupported product question
hard_assertion: the assistant abstains without inventing a fact

name: retrieval or model timeout
hard_assertion: safe fallback preserves draft and checkpoint

name: stale result after interruption
hard_assertion: stale result has no state or audio effect

name: projection continuity across corrections
hard_assertion: hypothetical calculations do not mutate the draft and confirmed corrections invalidate old projections
